ui.title: ✨ Equestria OS Character Theme
ui.subtitle: Select character
ui.delete_msg: Are you sure you want to delete '{0}'?
ui.mode_auto_tip: Light by day, dark at night — on the KDE schedule
ui.mode_light_tip: Always light; automatic switching is turned off
ui.mode_dark_tip: Always dark; automatic switching is turned off
pal.title: Interface colors
pal.hint: Equestria apps and KDE apps (Dolphin, Kate…) both use these colors. Night and day colors are set separately. Until you change the day colors, they are derived from the night palette automatically.
pal.mode_tip: Which half of the pair you are editing: night or day.
pal.day_auto: Day is derived from night until you touch it. Any color you pick here is kept as is.
pal.kde_bg_tip: For the whole style: windows, lists, buttons and title bars look like the regular KDE theme (Breeze). Only the character's accent and selection remain. Your background colors are kept.
pal.reset_day_tip: Discards only your day color edits: day is derived from night again.
pal.reset_tip: Discards your color edits for this character (applied on Save).
pal.warn: Low contrast: {0} on “{1}” is {2}:1. KDE will adjust the text color so it stays readable.
kbd.title: Keyboard backlight
kbd.hint: Color of the keyboard light for this character. With “Rainbow” ticked, the keyboard shows a rainbow if it can; otherwise this color is used. Applied by the keyboard page of Equestria OS Settings when it follows the theme.
kbd.needs_settings: Preview and applying need the equestria-os-settings package, which is not installed.
